title: Fifteen randomly selected unchanged Laravel questions
note: All student-visible text plus keys and rationales for reviewer use. The quiz randomizes display order.

questions.prompt: An API requires items to have consecutive numeric keys starting at zero. The directly decoded input [1 => "A", 2 => "B"] must be rejected, not reindexed. Which rules enforce the shape?
options: Apply array_values before using required|array.
required|array
required|array|min:2
required|array|list
coreOptions: Apply array_values before using required|array.
required|array
required|array|min:2
required|array|list
questions.explanation: list requires consecutive numeric keys starting at zero, in addition to the array requirement.

learning.trace: list requires consecutive numeric keys starting at zero, in addition to the array requirement.
rationales: Reindexing transforms the invalid shape into a list instead of rejecting it as required.
An array can have arbitrary keys, so this permits the invalid shape.
The payload already has two entries; a count minimum does not establish its key sequence.
list requires consecutive numeric keys starting at zero, in addition to the array requirement.

questions.prompt: At the point shown, what is printed? No response has been sent yet.
options: ran without a,b
a,bran
pending

coreOptions: ran without a,b
a,bran
pending

learning.trace: Constructing the streamed response stores the callback; content sending executes it later.

files.name: probe.php
files.snippet:
<?php

$ran = false;
$response = response()->streamDownload(function () use (&$ran): void {
    $ran = true;
    echo 'a,b';
}, 'report.csv');

echo $ran ? 'ran' : 'pending';

rationales: A connection failure is represented by an exception because no response status exists to inspect.
